categories.name: Final Value
categories.description: Your character receives one final value. It might reflect the career events you chose, or some other element of who they have become.

categories.name: Attributes
categories.description: Increase two attributes by 1 each, then bring every attribute within the book's limits. This fixes your final attribute scores.

categories.name: Disciplines
categories.description: Increase two disciplines by 1 each, then bring every discipline within the book's limits. This fixes your final discipline scores.

categories.name: Talent
categories.description: Choose one extra talent, bringing you to a total of four. Its requirements are checked against your final scores.

categories.name: Portrait
categories.description: Choose a portrait that represents your character. It is shown in the character summary and has no game-rule effect.

categories.name: Name & Pronouns
categories.description: Name your character and record their pronouns. Pronouns help others use the proper address for your character.

categories.name: Background Notes
categories.description: Optional notes about your character's history and personality. Free text that is saved with the character but never used by the game rules.

notes: Prototype: cards follow the unlock order, with Name & Pronouns as the last required choice and the optional Background Notes after it.

The Talent card comes from Star Trek Adventures 2E (Core p.131: 'select one extra talent, bringing you to a total of four'); it follows Disciplines so talent requirements are checked against final scores.
Screen 07 is Book Step Seven. Assignment and Rank from Step Seven are on Screen 05.

Prototype: Name (required), Portrait (required), and Background Notes (optional) are videogame additions. The book's lifepath has no naming step. Pronouns are from p.132 and, as in the book, required.
Player-facing text never labels anything as a book rule, adaptation, or original system; provenance stays in data (sourceType) and these notes.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): the mockup's Service Motto and Personal Goals are dropped from the design (Service Motto would duplicate Values).
Limits follow the book: when scores exceed them, the player chooses which tied score keeps the maximum and where each reduced point goes.
The mockup's Randomize category is replaced by the per-screen Auto button. Category images point into public/; missing files fall back to the placeholder portrait.
